about: Zadok falls as if dead on seeing that Zion is gone, and his cry brings the king, who commands a pursuit and vows death to the thieves. Solomon sets out in anger as Israel weeps; his horsemen learn in Egypt, and he himself at Gaza, that the Ethiopians passed days ago in flying carts, and that nothing was seen of Zion.

sentences.l: And-when he-lingered to-come-out, sent to-him Joash (ኢዮአስ) son-of Jehoiada, and-found-him fallen like corpse, and-raised-him, his-head, and-felt-him his-heart, and-(to)-his-nose (?) if he-find warm (?) breath in-him, and-blew-on-him, and-raised-him, and-shook-him, and-set-him (?) to table; and-rose, and-looked toward her-seat, of-Zion, and-did-not-find-her;
sentences.i: And when he delayed in coming out, the king (?) sent Joash son of Jehoiada to him, and he found him lying like a corpse; he lifted his head, felt his heart, and held something to his nose (?) to see whether he might find warm (?) breath in him; he breathed on him, raised him, shook him (?), and set him (?) at the table. Then Zadok rose and looked toward the seat of Zion, and did not find her;
sentences.n: Unit of 34 words, cut at the ፤. ወሶበ ጐንደየ ወፂአ 'and when he lingered (ጐንደየ, perfect) to come out' (ወፂአ infinitive of ወፅአ, 'coming out'). ለአከ ሎቱ 'sent to him': the sender is the king, never named (?). ኢዮአስ ወልደ ዮዳሔ is printed so (Joash son of Jehoiada); the names are kept as printed, and the pairing is borrowed from 2 Kings 11–12, which is far later than Solomon's time. The run of ወ-verbs (ወረከቦ 'and found him', ወአንሥኦ 'and raised him', ወገሰሶ 'and felt', ወነፍሖ 'and blew on him', ወነገፎ 'and shook him') uses the suffix -o 'him' on each; ርእሶ and ልቦ are accusatives with 'his'. ወአንፎ 'put to the nose' is uncertain (?) (from አንፍ 'nose'). እመ ይረክብ 'whether he might find'. ምዉቀ እስትንፋስ is UNCERTAIN: ምዉቅ is not the word for 'known' (that is ዕዉቅ); the shape is that of a passive participle like ምዉት 'dead', so perhaps 'warm' from ሞቀ 'be warm' (?), giving 'warm breath' (?). ወአፅግዖ ውስተ ጠረጲዛ 'and (?) him to the table' is uncertain in the verb: 'set him against / lean him on the table' is a guess. The subject then shifts without notice: ወተንሥአ ወነጸረ 'and he rose and looked' is Zadok. ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'her seat, of Zion' (suffix anticipating the genitive).

sentences.i: The king rose and commanded that heralds should go about (?) and blow the horn of war, so that they might go and pursue the men of the land of Ethiopia; and if they found them, they were to seize his son and bring him back with Zion, and to kill them all by the edge of the sword;
sentences.n: Unit of 26 words. አዘዘ 'he commanded', followed by the subjunctives ይዑዱ … ወይንፍሑ 'that they … and blow' (the subjunctive without ከመ after a verb of command). ይዑዱ ዐዋዲ is UNCERTAIN: ዐዋዲ may be 'heralds, criers' (?) and ይዑዱ some verb of going round or proclaiming (?). ቀርነ ፀባኢት 'horn-of war' (construct; ፀባኢት 'war, host'). ከመ ይሖሩ ወይስድድዎ 'that they go and pursue them' (ሰደደ 'pursue, drive'; -ዎ is the 3ms object 'him' after the plural -u, here collective, doubled by ለሰብአ). ለእመ 'if'; ረከቦሙ 'he found them' (3ms perfect + -ሙ; the subject is unstated). The object of የአኀዞ ለወልዱ 'that they seize him, his son' is doubled (-ዎ … ለወልዱ), and 'his son' is presumably Menelik, Solomon's son by the Queen of Sheba (?). በአፈ ኀጺን 'with the mouth-of iron' is Hebrew-style 'edge of the sword'.

sentences.i: For with his mouth he spoke and said: 'As God lives, the God of Israel, these are men of death and not of life; for in truth death is their due, because they have stolen the house of the sanctuary of God and have wished to defile the dwelling of His name in a land that has no law.'
sentences.n: እስመ 'for'. በአፉሁ 'with his mouth' (አፍ + ሁ). ሕያው እግዚኣብሔር 'living is God' is the oath formula 'as the Lord lives' (compare 1 Samuel 14:39), here with አምላከ እስራኤል in apposition (construct). ሰብአ ሞት 'men-of death'; ኢኮኑ ለሕይወት 'they are not for life' (ኮነ 'be' negated). ይደልዎሙ ሞት 'death befits them' (ደለወ 'be fitting, due', object -ሙ). በእንተ ዘሰረቁ 'because of that which they stole'. ቤተ መቅደሱ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the house of his sanctuary, of God', and ማኅደረ ስሙ 'dwelling-of his name' (Deuteronomy 12:11 style; the 'name' dwelling is the Zion theology). ዘአልቦ ሕገ 'which has no law' (አልቦ 'there is not' + accusative ሕገ). sentences.i: And to us it seemed to be your own doing, a thing you had made for them by your wisdom, that they travel in a cart above the wind.'
sentences.n: ወለነሰ 'and as for us' (ለ- + ነ + ሰ). መሰለነ 'it seemed to us' (መሰለ 'resemble, seem' + -ነ). ዘአንተ ረሰይከ ሎሙ 'what you yourself made for them' (ረሰየ 'make, set, appoint'; the -ከ is 'you'). በጥበብከ 'by your wisdom'. ከመ ይሖሩ 'that they go'. This is the explanation of the people of Gaza (the king has just reached Gaza), who flatter him: they suppose the king himself had provided the flying cart.

glossary.ወለነኒ: ለ — and as for us too (ወ- + ለ- + -ነ '1cp us' + -ኒ 'also')
glossary.ወለእመ: እመ — and if (ወ- + ለእመ, conditional conjunction)
glossary.ወሐተቱ: ሐተተ — and they questioned, inquired (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḥ-t-t)
glossary.ወሖረ: ሖረ — and he went (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወሖሩ: ሖረ — and they went (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.ወመኳንንቲሁ: መኰንን — and his nobles, governors (ወ- + plural መኳንንት + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወረከቦ: ረከበ — and he found him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.ወርእዮ: ርእየ — and he saw him (ወ- + 3m sg perfect + -o, r-ʾ-y) · and seeing, and when he saw (ወ- + infinitive ርእዮ, circumstantial, with accusative object ዘንተ 'this')
glossary.ወሰራዊቱ: ሰራዊት — and his army (ወ- + noun + -ሁ '3ms his')
glossary.ወበጽሑ: በጽሐ — and they arrived (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወቦ: ቦ — and there is (ወ- + existential ቦ 'there is')
glossary.ወተምዐ: ተምዐ — and he was angry (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወተሰምዐ: ተሰምዐ — and it was heard (ወ- + 3ms perfect, passive-reflexive of ሰምዐ, s-m-ʿ)
glossary.ወተስእሎሙ: ተስእለ — and he asked them (ወ- + 3ms perfect, tä-stem, s-ʾ-l + -ሙ '3mp them')
glossary.ወተንሥአ: ተንሥአ — and he arose (ወ- + 3ms perfect, Gt)
glossary.ወተክዕወት: ተክዕወ — and was poured out (ወ- + 3fs perfect, tä-stem passive, k-ʿ-w; subject ነፍሱ) (?)
glossary.ወተፈሥሑ: ተፈሥሐ — and they rejoiced (ወ- + 3mp perfect, tä-stem)
glossary.ወኀያላኒሁ: ኀያል — and his mighty ones (ወ- + plural ኀያላን + -ሁ '3ms his'; adjective used as noun)
glossary.ወነገርዎ: ነገረ — and they told him (ወ- + 3mpl perfect, G + -ዎ 3ms object)
glossary.ወነገፎ: ነገፈ — and he shook him (?) (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, n-g-f + -o 'him'); the root sense is uncertain (?)
glossary.ወነጸረ: ነጸረ — and he looked (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, n-ṣ-r)
glossary.ወነፍሖ: ነፍሐ — and he blew on him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, n-f-ḥ + -o 'him')
glossary.ወንሕነሰ: ንሕነ — and as for us (ወ- + 1cp independent pronoun + contrastive -ሰ)
glossary.ወአብያጺነሰ: ብጻይ — and our companions (?) (ወ- + plural አብያጽ + -ነ '1cp our' + contrastive -ሰ); the identification is uncertain (?)
glossary.ወአንሥኦ: አንሥአ — and he raised him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative, n-ś-ʾ + -ኦ 'him'; subject not stated) · or here perhaps ወ- + infinitive አንሥኦ 'and to lift up', before ኵናቶ (?)
glossary.ወአንፎ: አንፍ — nose (noun): ወአንፎ 'and (he held it) to his nose' (ወ- + noun + -o 'his') (?); possibly instead a denominal verb 'and he put to the nose' (?); the form is uncertain
glossary.ወአዘዘ: አዘዘ — and he commanded (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ወአፅግዖ: አፅግዐ — and he set him (?), leaned him (?) (ወ- + 3ms perfect, causative + -o 'him'); root not identified, meaning guessed from the context (?)
glossary.ወአፍጠኑ: አፍጠነ — and they hastened (ወ- + 3mp perfect, causative, f-ṭ-n)
glossary.ወኢረከባ: ረከበ — and he did not find her (ወ- + ኢ- + 3ms perfect, G + -ሃ '3fs her')
glossary.ወኢኮኑ: ኮነ — and they are not (ወ- + ኢ- + 3mp perfect, 'be, become')
glossary.ወከልሐ: ከልሐ — and he cried out (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, k-l-ḥ)
glossary.ወኮነ: ኮነ — and it was, became (ወ- + 3m sg perfect)
glossary.ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
glossary.ወወደየ: ወደየ — and he put, placed (ወ- + 3m sg perfect, w-d-y)
glossary.ወወድቀ: ወድቀ — and he fell (ወ- + 3ms perfect, w-d-q)
glossary.ወያግብኦ: አግብአ — and that he bring him back (ወ- + 3ms subjunctive, causative of ገብአ + -ኦ 'him'; the subject is impersonal here) (?)
glossary.ወይስድድዎ: ሰደደ — and that they pursue him/them (ወ- + 3mp subjunctive, G, s-d-d + -ዎ 'him', here collective, doubled by ለሰብአ)
glossary.ወይቀልሉ: ቀለለ — and they are swift, light (ወ- + 3mp imperfect, G, q-l-l)
glossary.ወይቅትሎሙ: ቀተለ — and that he kill them (ወ- + 3ms subjunctive, G, q-t-l + -ሙ 'them'; the subject is impersonal here) (?)
glossary.ወይቤሉ: ብህለ — and they said (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l)
glossary.ወይቤልዎ: ብህለ — and they said to him (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎ 'to him')
glossary.ወይቤልዎሙ: ብህለ — and they said to them (ወ- 'and' + 3mp perfect ይቤሉ of b-h-l + -ልዎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይቤሎሙ: ብህለ — and he said to them (ወ- + 3ms perfect ይቤ of b-h-l + -ሎሙ 'to them')
glossary.ወይንግርዎ: ነገረ — and that they tell him (ወ- + 3mp subjunctive, G + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.ወይንፍሑ: ነፍሐ — and that they blow (ወ- + 3mp subjunctive, G, n-f-ḥ)
glossary.ወይግብኡ: ገብአ — and that they return (ወ- + 3mp subjunctive, G, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ወደናግል: ድንግል — and virgins, maidens (ወ- + plural ደናግል)
glossary.ወገሰሶ: ገሰሰ — and he felt him, touched him (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, g-s-s + -ዎ 'him')
glossary.ወገባእነ: ገብአ — and we returned (ወ- + 1cp perfect, G; spelled ገባእነ)
glossary.ወፂአ: ወፅአ — coming out, to come out (infinitive, accusative, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወፅኡ: ወፅአ — they went out (3mp perfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
glossary.ወፅግመ: ፅግም — and left side (ወ- + noun, adverbial accusative 'to the left')
glossary.ወፈቀዱ: ፈቀደ — and they wished (ወ- + 3mp perfect, G)
glossary.ወፈነወ: ፈነወ — and he sent (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, f-n-w)
glossary.ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
glossary.ውዱቀ: ውዱቅ — fallen, lying fallen (passive participle of ወድቀ, accusative, predicate after ረከቦ)
glossary.ውድቀተ: ውድቀት — fall (noun, verbal noun of ወድቀ; construct 'fall-of')
glossary.ዐዋዲ: ዐዋዲ — herald, crier (?) (noun, perhaps agent noun of ዖደ 'go about'; sense uncertain) (?)
glossary.ዘሀለወት: ሀለወ — who was (ዘ- relative + 3fs perfect, agreeing with ጽዮን)
glossary.ዘርኢነ: ርእየ — what we saw, that which we saw (ዘ- + 1cp perfect, r-ʾ-y)
glossary.ዘሰረቁ: ሰረቀ — which they stole, that which they stole (ዘ- + 3mp perfect, G, s-r-q)
glossary.ዘአልቦ: አልቦ — which has not, there is not (ዘ- + አልቦ 'not-with-him', negative existential)
glossary.ዘአንተ: ዘ — what you yourself, that which you (relative ዘ- + independent pronoun አንተ '2ms')
glossary.ዘየሐውር: ሖረ — which goes, travels (ዘ- relative + 3ms imperfect, G)
glossary.የሐውር: ሖረ — he walks, goes (3ms imperfect, ḥ-w-r)
glossary.የአኀዞ: አኀዘ — that he seize him, that they seize him (3ms subjunctive, G, ʾ-ḫ-z + -ዎ 'him'; the subject is impersonal here) (?)
glossary.ያርኵሱ: አርኰሰ — that they defile (3mp subjunctive, causative, r-k-s)
glossary.ያእምሩ: አእመረ — that they know, learn (3mp subjunctive, ʾ-ʿ-m-r)
glossary.ይምነ: የማን — right, right side (noun, here adverbial 'to the right'; spelled ይምነ)
glossary.ይረክብ: ረከበ — he finds, may find (3ms imperfect/subjunctive, G, r-k-b)
glossary.ይቅትሎሙ: ቀተለ — that he kill them (3ms subjunctive, G, q-t-l + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ይበጽሑ: በጽሐ — they would reach (3mp imperfect/subjunctive, G, b-ṣ-ḥ)
glossary.ይትገሐሡ: ተገሐሠ — they hasten, move about (?) (3mp subjunctive, tä-stem); root and sense uncertain, perhaps related to ገሠሠ 'go about' (?)
glossary.ይኅሥሡ: ኀሠሠ — that they seek (3mp subjunctive, G, ḫ-ś-ś)
glossary.ይኅሥሦሙ: ኀሠሠ — that he seek them (3ms subjunctive, G, ḫ-ś-ś + -ሙ 'them')
glossary.ይእቲ: ይእቲ — she/it is (fem. pron.) · 'I am she' predicate (አነ ይእቲ አቡከ 'I am she, your father') · 'that' (fem. demonstrative, ይእቲ ሠሉስ ዕለት 'that third day')
glossary.ይዑዱ: ዖደ — that they go about, circulate (3mp subjunctive, ʿ-w-d) (?)
glossary.ይደልዎሙ: ደለወ — it is due to them, befits them (3ms imperfect, G, d-l-w + -ዎሙ 'them')
glossary.ዮምበዕለተ: ዮም — today, on the day of (ዮም + በ- + ዕለተ construct, printed as one word)
glossary.ደንገፀ: ደንገፀ — he was startled (3ms perfect, d-n-g-ḍ)
glossary.ገባእነ: ገብአ — we returned (1cp perfect, G, g-b-ʾ; spelled ገባእነ)
glossary.ገብአ: ገብአ — he returned (3ms perfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ገብኡ: ገብአ — they returned (3mp perfect, G, g-b-ʾ)
glossary.ግብጽ: ግብጽ — Egypt (proper name; genitive after construct)
glossary.ጐንደየ: ጐንደየ — he lingered, delayed (3ms perfect, G)
glossary.ጠረጲዛ: ጠረጲዛ — table (noun; loan from Greek trapeza)
glossary.ጸዐኑ: ጸዐነ — they loaded (3mp perfect, G, as ወጸዐኑ in ch. 51–52); 'mounted' is possible (?)
glossary.ፀባኢት: ፀባኢት — war, battle, host (noun; ቀርነ ፀባኢት 'horn of war')
glossary.ፈነውከነ: ፈነወ — you sent us (2ms perfect, G + -ነ '1cp us')
glossary.፶፯: ፶፯ — fifty-seven; spoken ኀምሳ ወሰብዐቱ (ḫämsa wä-säbʿätu) 'fifty-seven' (numeral, chapter number)
glossary.፶፰: ፶፰ — fifty-eight; spoken ኀምሳ ወሰመንቱ (ḫämsa wä-sämäntu) 'fifty-eight' (numeral, chapter number)
